description: Genre-to-engine routing contract. Genres choose a primary production recipe; conditional tools never silently replace the primary renderer.

historical-military-animation.when: User explicitly requests animated ancient, medieval, samurai, Viking or other military history in the Squire vector-animation look.
primaryTools: VoiceStudio reusable GitHub Actions narration workflow
conditionalTools: Blender for selected shots that materially benefit from real 3D depth or simulation
Krita for painted map or texture inserts
requiredEvidence: VoiceStudio PCM-24 WAV, captions and verified watermark manifest
ASR-assisted line/word timing report with interpolation clearly labelled
SHA-256 checksums and full-motion/audio human-review log
guardrails: Do not substitute Remotion and call it Squire.
Treat ancient troop counts and casualty counts as estimates and attribute them.
Label visual formations as explanatory reconstructions.
Use historically appropriate but source-backed presets; identify generic character presets as visual shorthand.
Do not overwrite archived masters or alter the parallel asset-library workstream.
A technical pass is not human artistic approval.
qaChecks: Voice ID resolves against the live manifest and published eligibility metadata.
Voice WAV checksum, PCM format and VoiceStudio watermark all pass.
Narration timeline preserves source WAV bytes and identifies ASR/interpolated words.
All Squire templates exist and no shot is longer than eight seconds without an editorial reason.
Contact sheets contain no missing shot/template/import errors.
Final output is 1920x1080, 24 fps, H.264 with AAC stereo 48 kHz.
Integrated loudness is approximately -14 LUFS and true peak remains below -1 dBTP.
Preview and complete moving-picture/audio review are retained separately.

cinematic-stick-figure-narrative.when: User requests the established emotional, story-led stick-figure cinematic look.
cinematic-stick-figure-narrative.primaryEngine: Existing H2 Canvas/Chromium or Remotion, selected per existing project
requiredEvidence: Contact sheets and motion frame samples
Final candidate checksum and full-motion/audio review
guardrails: Do not switch to Squire unless the user requests Squire military history.
qaChecks: Character continuity and contact physics are inspected.
Shot variety and motivated camera movement are verified.
Captions are readable and synchronized.
Audio and full-film review are complete.

mathematical-scientific-explainer.when: User requests mathematics, science or technical concepts that benefit from geometric or data-driven explanation.
mathematical-scientific-explainer.primaryEngine: Manim or Remotion according to mathematical complexity and editorial needs
requiredEvidence: Render preview and full technical QA
guardrails: Mathematical correctness takes priority over decorative motion.
Do not animate a false derivation or misleading graph.
qaChecks: Equations and labels are readable.
Graph scales and units are correct.
No key transformation is skipped in the explanation.

product-ui-walkthrough.when: User requests a product or UI walkthrough that must reflect real application state.
product-ui-walkthrough.primaryEngine: Authorized Playwright browser capture plus Remotion editorial timeline
requiredEvidence: Timeline, captions and final output checksums
guardrails: Do not fabricate product states or claim an interaction occurred if it was not observed.
qaChecks: Every shown interaction corresponds to captured evidence.
UI text is legible at delivery resolution.
No credentials, private user data or unintended tabs are shown.

cinematic-3d-sequence.when: A sequence materially benefits from spatial geometry, lighting, camera or physical simulation.
conditionalTools: Remotion for compositing and title integration
guardrails: Use 3D only when it materially improves the shot.
Keep render settings and assets reproducible.
qaChecks: Camera, geometry, lighting and frame sequence are validated.
No missing frames or unresolved render errors.
